status_rules.VERIFIED: Stated by one party and acknowledged by the other, or read back, before the hand-off line.
status_rules.PENDING: Stated once, in the last turn(s) before the hand-off, without acknowledgement or read-back.
status_rules.MISSING: Required but not established before the hand-off (see missing_reason).
